about.title: About this site
about.sub: Hyeri's Thai fan base: built by fans, for fans.
about.what: {brand} is an unofficial Thai fan base for Hyeri (Lee Hye-ri), run by Thai fans. It is not affiliated with Hyeri, her agency Sublime, or any broadcaster.
about.source: Facts on this site are summarized and translated from the Korean namu.wiki article on Hyeri. Text from namu.wiki is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 KR, so the content of this site is shared under the same license.
about.images: Videos are embedded from official YouTube channels. Photos are only added by admins who have the right to share them. If you own an image here and want it removed, please contact the site admin.
about.updateTitle: How it stays up to date
about.update: Admins compare the site with the source article and send updates through the Admin page. Bigger changes, like new pages, are built by Claude AI following this site's design rules and are reviewed before going live.
about.external: Posters, synopses and photos come from TMDB (The Movie Database). Music videos and channel stats come from the YouTube Data API. Both are refreshed automatically every week. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
